title: Transcripts embed backfill has no run-to-convergence mode: each reembed call drives one 10k wave
wanted_capability: An unattended convergence path for the transcripts bucket. The residue sweeper deliberately never auto-sweeps transcripts (heavy corpus scan guard, embed_runtime.rs ~line 831), and bbox_reembed's message claims "residue past the queue cap converges automatically via the background sweeper", which is false for the transcripts route: each explicit call enqueues one MAX_ROUTE_QUEUE_DEPTH (10k) wave and then progress halts. A ~279k-doc corpus cutover needs ~27 hand-driven waves. Wanted: either an opt-in run-to-convergence flag on bbox_reembed(transcripts) that keeps refilling until enqueueable residue is zero (keeping the guard as the consent gate), or at minimum a truthful tool message for the guarded route.
fallback_used: Background shell driver looping tools/call bbox_reembed over the streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint (?surface=interactive + service-token bearer), waiting for queue drain per wave, terminating on partition active_count flatline (scratchpad backfill-driver.sh, cage cutover 2026-07-17).
